events.name: The invention of writing
events.hook: Temple clerks in Sumer pressed marks into clay to count sheep and barley, and history began.

events.name: Building the Great Pyramid
events.hook: For nearly 4,000 years the tomb of King Khufu was the tallest building on Earth.

events.name: The Bronze Age collapse
events.hook: Within fifty years the great kingdoms of the eastern Mediterranean fell, and no one is sure why.

events.name: The Trojan War
events.hook: A legend of a stolen queen, a ten-year siege and a wooden horse, with a real burned city underneath.

events.name: The first Olympic Games
events.hook: One footrace at a shrine of Zeus began a festival that lasted a thousand years and came back in 1896.

events.name: The Greco-Persian Wars
events.hook: The largest empire on Earth twice invaded Greece, and was beaten at Marathon, Salamis and Plataea.

events.name: The Peloponnesian War
events.hook: Athens and Sparta fought for 27 years, and the golden age of Athens ended in plague, defeat and hunger.

events.name: Alexander's conquest of Persia
events.hook: In eleven years a young king of Macedon marched from Greece to India and toppled the Persian Empire.

events.name: The Punic Wars
events.hook: Rome and Carthage fought three wars for the Mediterranean, and only one city survived.

events.name: The Kalinga War
events.hook: One bloody conquest made the emperor Ashoka turn away from war and preach kindness across India.

events.name: The Qin unification of China
events.hook: After centuries of war one kingdom swallowed the other six, and its king made himself the First Emperor.

events.name: The Silk Road opens
events.hook: A Han envoy's thirteen-year journey opened the roads that carried silk, horses, faiths and plague across Asia.

events.name: Caesar's Gallic Wars
events.hook: Julius Caesar conquered Gaul in eight years of war, and wrote the story of it himself.

events.name: The fall of the Roman Republic
events.hook: Rome's generals turned their armies on each other, and a republic of nearly five centuries ended with an emperor.

events.name: The Roman conquest of Britain
events.hook: Rome took Britain in forty years of war, and Queen Boudica nearly drove it out again.

events.name: The Jewish revolts against Rome
events.hook: Judea rose against Rome again and again. Rome destroyed the Temple of Jerusalem and renamed the land.

events.name: The eruption of Vesuvius
events.hook: In two days a volcano buried Pompeii and Herculaneum, and kept a Roman town exactly as it was.
events.wiki: Eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79 AD

events.name: The Three Kingdoms
events.hook: As the Han dynasty fell apart, warlords fought for a century, and their story became China's favourite novel.

events.name: Rome becomes Christian
events.hook: In less than a century Christianity went from a hunted faith to the religion of the Roman Empire.

events.name: The fall of the Western Roman Empire
events.hook: Goths, Huns and Vandals broke into a divided empire, and in 476 the last emperor in the west was sent into retirement.
events.wiki: Fall of the Western Roman Empire

events.name: The Plague of Justinian
events.hook: The first known pandemic of plague swept the Roman world and Persia, and kept coming back for two hundred years.

events.name: The early Muslim conquests
events.hook: Within a century of Muhammad's death, Arab armies built an empire from Spain to the Indus.

events.name: The Reconquista
events.hook: Over seven centuries the Christian kingdoms of the north took Spain and Portugal from their Muslim rulers.

events.name: The An Lushan Rebellion
events.hook: A favourite general turned on the Tang emperor, and China's golden age ended in eight years of war.

events.name: The Viking Age
events.hook: Norse raiders, traders and settlers sailed from Scandinavia to Baghdad, Constantinople and America.

events.name: The Polynesian voyages
events.hook: Steering by stars, waves and birds, Polynesian sailors found and settled nearly every island of the Pacific.

events.name: The Norman Conquest
events.hook: Three men wanted the English crown in 1066. The Duke of Normandy won it at Hastings, and England was never the same.

events.name: The Crusades
events.hook: For two centuries Christian armies from Europe fought for Jerusalem and the Holy Land.

events.name: Great Zimbabwe
events.hook: Africans built a city of stone walls on a granite hill, grew rich on gold, and gave a country its name.

events.name: The Genpei War
events.hook: Two samurai clans fought for Japan. The war ended with a drowned child emperor and the first shogun.

events.name: The Mongol conquests
events.hook: In two generations the horsemen of the steppe built the largest land empire the world has ever seen.

events.name: Magna Carta
events.hook: Rebel barons made King John promise that even a king must obey the law.

events.name: The rise of the Ottoman Empire
events.hook: A small Turkish band on the Byzantine frontier grew into an empire on three continents.
st: Emirate of the White Sheep Turks

events.name: Tenochtitlan
events.hook: Wanderers from the north founded a city on a lake island, and it became the heart of the Aztec world.

events.name: The Hundred Years' War
events.hook: The kings of England fought for the crown of France for 116 years, until a peasant girl turned the tide.

events.name: The Black Death
events.hook: The deadliest pandemic in recorded history killed a third or more of Europe in four years.

events.name: The printing revolution
events.hook: A goldsmith in Mainz printed with metal type, and in fifty years Europe was flooded with books.

events.name: The fall of Constantinople
events.hook: A sultan of 21 with giant cannon took the city of the Caesars, and the Roman Empire came to an end.

events.name: The Wars of the Roses
events.hook: Two branches of England's royal family fought over the crown for thirty years, until a Tudor took it.

events.name: Japan's age of warring states
events.hook: For 150 years Japanese warlords fought each other, until three men in turn united the country.

events.name: Portugal's sea road to India
events.hook: Portuguese sailors rounded Africa, reached India by sea and built an empire of forts on the Indian Ocean.

events.name: Columbus's first voyage
events.hook: Three small ships sailed west to find Asia and found a world Europe did not know.

events.name: The Reformation
events.hook: A monk's protest against the sale of forgiveness split Western Christianity in two.

events.name: The first voyage around the world
events.hook: Five ships and some 270 men sailed west for the Spice Islands. Three years later one ship came home.

events.name: The fall of the Aztecs and the Incas
events.hook: A few hundred Spaniards, their native allies and smallpox brought down the two greatest empires of the Americas.
events.wiki: Spanish conquest of the Aztec Empire

events.name: The founding of the Mughal Empire
events.hook: A prince from Central Asia with cannon and a small army won North India at Panipat.

events.name: The Atlantic slave trade
events.hook: For three and a half centuries, European ships carried 12 million Africans in chains to the Americas.

events.name: Russia conquers Kazan and Siberia
events.hook: The first tsar took the Tatar khanates of the Volga, and Cossacks crossed the Urals into Siberia.

events.name: The Spanish Armada
events.hook: Spain sent a great fleet to invade England. Fire ships and Atlantic storms destroyed it.

events.name: The Imjin War
events.hook: Japan's ruler tried to conquer China through Korea. An admiral with ironclad turtle ships helped stop him.

events.name: The Thirty Years' War
events.hook: A quarrel over faith in Bohemia grew into a war of all Europe that left much of Germany in ruins.

events.name: The fall of the Ming
events.hook: Rebels took Beijing, the last Ming emperor hanged himself, and the Manchus rode in to found the Qing.

events.name: Building the Taj Mahal
events.hook: A grieving emperor built a tomb of white marble for his wife, and the world still comes to see it.

events.name: The English Civil War
events.hook: King and Parliament went to war. The king lost his head, and England tried living without a monarch.

events.name: The siege of Vienna, 1683
events.hook: An Ottoman army besieged Vienna. A great cavalry charge broke it, and the Ottoman tide began to turn.

events.name: The Great Northern War
events.hook: Peter the Great fought Sweden for 21 years, built a new capital on the Baltic and made Russia a European power.

events.name: The Seven Years' War
events.hook: Britain and France fought on four continents, and Britain came out with the greatest empire on Earth.

events.name: The Lisbon earthquake
events.hook: On All Saints' Day an earthquake, a tsunami and fire destroyed Lisbon and shook Europe's faith in a kind God.

events.name: The Industrial Revolution
events.hook: In Britain, machines driven by water, coal and steam began to make things faster than any hands could.
st: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

events.name: The American Revolution
events.hook: Thirteen colonies rose against Britain, declared that all men are created equal, and won their independence.

events.name: The First Fleet
events.hook: Eleven ships brought convicts to found a British colony in Australia, on land its peoples had lived on for 50,000 years.

events.name: The French Revolution
events.hook: The people of France overthrew their king and their nobles in the name of liberty, equality and fraternity.

events.name: The Haitian Revolution
events.hook: Enslaved Africans in France's richest colony rose up, beat three empires and founded the free nation of Haiti.

events.name: The Napoleonic Wars
events.hook: For twelve years Napoleon fought nearly every power in Europe, and redrew its map from Lisbon to Moscow.
st: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

events.name: Serbia and Greece break free
events.hook: First the Serbs, then the Greeks rose against Ottoman rule, and in the end Europe's great powers sailed in to help.
st: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

events.name: Latin America breaks free
events.hook: When Napoleon seized Spain, its American empire began to break away, and in 18 years almost all of it was free.
st: Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata
United Provinces of the Río de la Plata

events.name: The War of 1812
events.hook: The young United States went to war with Britain, invaded Canada, saw its capital burned and found an anthem.
st: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

events.name: The Trail of Tears
events.hook: The United States forced the Cherokee and other nations of the southeast from their homelands to the far west.

events.name: The Opium Wars
events.hook: Britain went to war to keep selling opium in China, and the Qing empire began a century of humiliation.
st: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

events.name: The Great Famine in Ireland
events.hook: A blight destroyed the potatoes that a third of Ireland lived on. A million people died and a million more left.
st: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

events.name: The Mexican-American War
events.hook: The United States invaded Mexico and took about half its land, from Texas to California.

events.name: The revolutions of 1848
events.hook: In a few weeks of 1848 revolution swept from Paris to Berlin, Vienna and Budapest. Within two years most had failed.

events.name: The unification of Italy
events.hook: A prime minister, a king and a red-shirted adventurer turned a patchwork of small states into one Italy.

events.name: The Taiping Rebellion
events.hook: A failed exam candidate who believed he was the younger brother of Jesus led a rising in which tens of millions died.

events.name: The Crimean War
events.hook: Britain, France and the Ottomans fought Russia in a war of blunders and cholera, and modern nursing was born.
st: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

events.name: The Meiji Restoration
events.hook: American warships forced Japan open, and in one lifetime it turned itself from a land of samurai into a modern power.

events.name: The Indian Rebellion of 1857
events.hook: Indian soldiers rose against the British East India Company, and the fighting ended the Company's rule of India.

events.name: The Suez Canal
events.hook: A French diplomat and tens of thousands of Egyptian labourers cut a waterway joining the Mediterranean to the Red Sea.

events.name: The American Civil War
events.hook: Eleven slave states broke away from the United States. Four years and over 600,000 deaths later, slavery was over.

events.name: The Paraguayan War
events.hook: Little Paraguay fought Brazil, Argentina and Uruguay all at once, and lost a huge share of its people.
st: United Provinces of the Río de la Plata

events.name: The unification of Germany
events.hook: In three short wars Prussia's Bismarck united Germany by blood and iron, and crowned its king emperor in France.

events.name: The Paris Commune
events.hook: For 72 days in 1871 the working people of Paris ran their own city, until the French army took it back.

events.name: The Panama Canal
events.hook: France failed, and the United States succeeded, in cutting a canal through the jungle from the Atlantic to the Pacific.

events.name: The Scramble for Africa
events.hook: In thirty years European powers carved up almost all of Africa. Only Ethiopia and Liberia stayed free.
st: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

events.name: The eruption of Krakatoa
events.hook: A volcanic island between Java and Sumatra blew itself apart with the loudest sound in recorded history.

events.name: The Boxer Rebellion
events.hook: Villagers who thought bullets could not harm them rose against foreigners in China, and eight nations marched in.
st: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

events.name: The Boer War
events.hook: Britain fought two Boer republics over gold and power, and won only by burning farms and filling camps.
st: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

events.name: The Russo-Japanese War
events.hook: Japan beat the Russian Empire on land and sea, the first time in modern times that an Asian power beat a European one.

events.name: The Mexican Revolution
events.hook: A rigged election set off ten years of war that brought down a dictator and gave land back to Mexico's farmers.

events.name: The 1911 Revolution in China
events.hook: A bomb that went off by accident set off the revolution that ended more than 2,000 years of emperors in China.

events.name: The sinking of the Titanic
events.hook: The biggest ship in the world, said to be unsinkable, struck an iceberg on her first voyage, and 1,500 people died.
st: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

events.name: The First World War
events.hook: Four years of trench war killed some ten million soldiers, brought down four empires and remade the map of the world.
st: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

events.name: The Armenian genocide
events.hook: During the First World War the Ottoman government drove its Armenians from their homes, and about a million died.

events.name: The Russian Revolution
events.hook: Russia's tsar fell in 1917, and Lenin's Bolsheviks took power and won a civil war to found the Soviet Union.

events.name: The flu of 1918
events.hook: A new flu swept the world in the last year of the First World War and killed more people than the war had.
st: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

events.name: The Chinese Civil War
events.hook: Chiang Kai-shek's Nationalists and Mao's Communists fought for China, on and off, for 22 years. The Communists won.

events.name: The Great Depression
events.hook: The Wall Street Crash of 1929 began the worst slump of modern times, and it helped bring Hitler to power.
st: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

events.name: The Holodomor
events.hook: Stalin's seizure of farms and grain brought a famine that killed millions in Soviet Ukraine and beyond.

events.name: The Holocaust
events.hook: Nazi Germany and its helpers murdered six million Jews, two in every three in Europe, and millions of others.

events.name: The Spanish Civil War
events.hook: Spain's generals rose against its republic, and volunteers, communists and fascists from abroad came to fight.

events.name: The Second Sino-Japanese War
events.hook: Japan invaded China in 1937, and eight years of war killed perhaps 15 to 20 million Chinese.

events.name: The Second World War
events.hook: The deadliest war in history, fought from Europe to the Pacific, killed some 70 to 85 million people.
